content:
Probably nobody gives a damn about my opinion, but I like the sms project, either with AI generated code or not. But if it’s gotta be generated, at least make sure is good and functioning.

As someone else said, not only has to be functioning, but readable, since AI tools are not yet able to produce high quality mods just by prompting. And it would also mean it’s a good way to learn. I never contributed since I still need the time to learn, but I could spin up my free Gemini and see what I could get out of it.

Also kudos to <@246956132600381442> and everybody contributed to this project for all this time. It takes some dedication.

content: `(void)0;` becomes a NOP statement internally and the heuristic for inlining is statement count

author: Mrkol
content: so when you are near the inlining boundary with statement count adding a single `(void)0;` can stop stuff from being inlined

content: MWCC works in mysterious ways
